title: High Risk of Extinction Across the Flowering Plant Tree of Life Revisited再探被子植物系统发育树上的高灭绝风险
content:
Two of the 200 randomized phylogenetic trees for species in the genus Magnolia used in Forest et al., showing that the branch length of a given species varies greatly among different phylogenetic trees.


ABSTRACT

Forest et al. (2026; Science, 392: 655−659) evaluated extinction risk for 335,497 angiosperm species worldwide, with the Evolutionarily Distinct and Globally Endangered (EDGE) approach, and identified 9945 EDGE species that disproportionately account for total threatened evolutionary history. Here, we demonstrate that Forest et al.'s results are severely flawed because the phylogenetic trees used by them are not appropriate for determining evolutionary distinctiveness of species and identifying EDGE species.

摘要

Forest 等 (2026；《Science》, 392:655–659) 采用“进化独特且全球濒危” (EDGE) 方法评估了全球 335,497 种被子植物的灭绝风险, 鉴定出 9,945 种 EDGE 物种, 并称其所代表的受威胁进化历史比例远高于其物种数量所占比例。本文指出, Forest 等的研究结果存在严重错误, 因其所使用的系统发育树不适于确定物种的进化独特性和鉴定 EDGE 物种。
